canonical_store.rationale: Google Drive owns source identity metadata, lifecycle events and immutable source payloads. GitHub remains the code, article-state and method-catalog authority; canonical article and method writes remain blocked while the repository is public and the hosted provider is not deployed. The source registry is not a second article ledger.

identity.version_id: vNNNN-<first 12 lowercase hex of exact stored payload SHA-256>
identity.revision_identity: A new immutable Drive file ID plus exact raw SHA-256 is mandatory; record the Drive revision ID when the connector exposes it.
identity.collision_check: Search Sources by source_id and canonical_url before committing a new identity.

registry.Sources: One immutable identity row per source_id, including title, publisher, URL, type, scope, task restriction and source folder ID.
registry.Versions: One immutable row per version, including exact Drive file/revision identity, stored payload hash, retained-text hash, source family, retrieval/publication times, rights and extractor metadata.
registry.Events: Append-only CREATE, ADD_VERSION, RETIRE, RESTORE and BLOCK lifecycle events. Google Sheets row order is authoritative event order.
registry.task_bindings: Not stored in the source registry. Session-only bindings remain in memory and the session work brief; canonical task bindings belong to the Article Aggregate only after provider deployment and repository privacy verification.

crud.create: Search for duplicates; mint source_id and v0001 from the exact retained payload; create source/version folders; upload only rights-permitted bytes, excerpt or metadata manifest; read back exact file ID, parent, optional revision, size, payload and extracted text; verify both hashes; append Sources, Versions and CREATE rows; read all rows back before reporting AVAILABLE.
crud.read: Resolve source_id/version_id through the registry, fetch by exact Drive file ID, and verify parent folder, optional revision, MIME type, byte size, raw SHA-256, retained-text SHA-256 and source family. Filename matching is never authoritative.
crud.update: Create a new version folder and new Drive file ID; never overwrite an accepted version. Verify the new payload, append one Versions row and ADD_VERSION event, then read back the registry. Old versions remain readable.
crud.delete: Ordinary delete means RETIRE: append a RETIRE event and move the source folder to 99_Retired. Keep referenced files and event history; do not physically delete.
crud.restore: Move the source folder back to 01_Sources and append a RESTORE event. Verify both lifecycle status and current-version availability.
crud.list_search: Search the Sources registry by source_id, title, publisher, URL, type or tags; use Drive folder listing only for object discovery, never as identity authority.

storage_policies.RAW_PRESERVED: Only user-provided, licensed or public-primary source material whose retention is lawful.
storage_policies.METADATA_AND_EXCERPT_ONLY: Store bibliographic metadata and only a permitted short excerpt; hash exactly what is retained.
storage_policies.LINK_ONLY: Store metadata and canonical URL; do not claim that the source body was preserved or byte-verified.

research_binding.session_mode: Build an in-memory SourceBindingSet pinned to the current research revision and exact artifact digests; retain its refs in the session work brief and deliverables.
research_binding.canonical_mode: Persist task bindings only inside the Article Aggregate through the hosted Provider Action after repository privacy and provider gates pass.
research_binding.exact_coverage: Every source ref in the admitted DecisionEnvelope, PrivateResearchBrief and ResearchPackage must equal the exact bound source_ref set.
research_binding.raw_urls: Discovery inputs only; never admitted durable research evidence refs.

execution_boundary.session_draft_delivery: May create, read, append immutable versions, retire and restore source objects and registry rows. It may not create canonical article state, persist a second task ledger or mutate the method catalog.
execution_boundary.canonical_article_and_method_writes: Hosted Financial Provider Action remains NOT_DEPLOYED; canonical writes stay blocked.
execution_boundary.public_repository: Do not add source files, private source metadata, research task bindings or private article artifacts while the repository remains public.

source_reader.verification: Exact file/folder identity, optional revision, MIME type, byte size, raw SHA-256, retained-text SHA-256 and source family.

rights_and_retention.news_media: Default to METADATA_AND_EXCERPT_ONLY or LINK_ONLY. Public accessibility is not permission to retain a full copyrighted article.
rights_and_retention.excerpts: Hash only the exact excerpt/metadata stored; never label it as a full-article hash.
rights_and_retention.publication: Never publish source originals or private research artifacts without explicit authorization.
